content.title: Chapter 74 - PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT — Sec. 74-96. - Recreation districts.
content.summary:

               …

faqs.a:
If the territory is within the peripheral boundaries of the Apex Park and Recreation
               District, or the Hyland Hills Metropolitan Park and Recreation District, a certificate
               signed by an officer of such district must be presented to the planning commission
               showing that such territory is, at the time of application, included within, and subject
               to the levy of taxes of, such district.
(Code 1960, § 2-5(J); Code 1981, § 25-62; Ord. No. 2481, § 1, 3-21-1988; Ord. No.
4848
, § 2, 7-10-2023)
State Law reference—
Metropolitan recreation districts, C.R.S. § 32-2-101 et seq.; officers of district
               board of directors, C.R.S. § 32-2-111; levy and collection of taxes, C.R.S. § 32-2-116
               et seq.
